summary: Final report OT-23-S0046 for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd: hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel on 44 compounds (Aminopyrimidine regioisomer). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: AP02 reserve analogues: integrated hERG and CYP screen, 44 compounds
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 44 compounds from the Avernelwick aminopyrimidine regioisomer series 02 were tested for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd in the hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel. Testing started on March 8, 2023 and results were reported on March 23, 2023. All runs met control validity criteria. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds were weak or inactive (IC50 at or above 10 µM, or above the top concentration). Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected.

This exploratory in vitro investigation is not conducted under GLP; procedures follow Osterquill standard operating procedures and the investigation is audited by Quality Assurance for data integrity only.
To rank the test article cohort for hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology, CYP safety interaction panel liability so that Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd could choose analogues for progression.
44 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test article cohort on March 8, 2023 and logged against OQ/2023/000755. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (KCNH2) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Control validity: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

All {{PRJ0013:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds were weak or inactive (IC50 at or above 10 µM, or above the top concentration). The median IC50 was {{PRJ0013:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0013:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0013:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0013:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0013:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the acceptance range.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected. In total {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). Ketoconazole inhibited CYP3A4 with an IC50 of {{PRJ0013:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.

No compound inhibited hERG with an IC50 below 1 µM. Most compounds were weak or inactive (IC50 at or above 10 µM, or above the top concentration). Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected. Results are exploratory and are intended for compound selection; they are not a substitute for a definitive GLP safety pharmacology study.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: select analogues without a hERG or CYP signal for further investigation and repeat any single-run outliers.
